thread:
Sam (support): FYI customer ACME seeing 400 from /v1/call_function when calling the `charge_account` tool. They passed a debug flag and got schema validation error: additionalProperties not allowed.
Meera (cs): Oof. Customer says it started after updating to our 2026-03 SDK. Says same payload worked before. Escalating.
ACME Integration Bot: payload sent by customer:
```json
{
  "account_id": "acct_789",
  "amount": 1200,
  "currency": "usd",
  "billing_profile": null,
  "dry_run": true,
  "meta": {"campaign": "spring-sale"}
}
```
ACME Integration Bot: API responded 400 with body:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Request validation failed",
    "code": "invalid_schema",
    "details": [
      {"path": "billing_profile", "message": "is required", "type": "required"},
      {"path": "dry_run", "message": "additional properties not allowed", "type": "additionalProperties"}
    ]
  }
}
```
Liam (eng): Thanks. Two distinct issues in one payload: 1) billing_profile null -> schema expects string (required) not null 2) dry_run is not in our function schema so it triggers additionalProperties. Can you confirm the function definition?
Ryan (backend): Function schema in prod for charge_account (v2.4.1) is:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["account_id", "amount", "currency", "billing_profile"],
  "properties": {
    "account_id": {"type": "string"},
    "amount": {"type": "number"},
    "currency": {"type": "string"},
    "billing_profile": {"type": "string"},
    "meta": {"type": "object"}
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
Meera (cs): ACME says they used to include dry_run as a non-persistent flag to run validations. They updated SDK and SDK started sending dry_run by default.
Sam (support): Customer wants a quick unblock; what are options?
Liam (eng): Options: 1) Tell customer to remove dry_run and set billing_profile to a string (quickest) 2) Patch function schema to allow additionalProperties: true (risk: hides other invalid keys) 3) Add explicit optional property dry_run: {type: boolean} and loosen billing_profile to allow null or optional. Preferred: add explicit dry_run boolean and accept null for billing_profile (or make it optional) then roll out as a non-breaking candidate that still validates important fields.
Ryan (backend): I can create a service patch to accept "billing_profile": ["string", "null"] (JSON Schema union) and add "dry_run": {"type": "boolean"} to properties. Will stage as canary on 2 hosts.
Meera (cs): Customer can update payload quickly but they'd like platform to be tolerant by default. Any ETA?
Liam (eng): If Ryan pushes a canary today, we can monitor for 1 hour, then promote. Update to schema registry + runtime change. ETA ~3-4 hours including tests.
Sam (support): I'll ask ACME to try temp workaround: set billing_profile to "default" and remove dry_run. Sending repro curl for them to test:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call_function \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"function":"charge_account","args":{"account_id":"acct_789","amount":1200,"currency":"usd","billing_profile":"default","meta":{"campaign":"spring-sale"}}}'
```
ACME Integration Bot: Will try and report back.
ACME Integration Bot: Confirmed: curl works, original SDK payload still 400s.
DeployBot: Canaries started on prod hosts: host-a, host-b (schema registry v2.4.2-canary).
Ryan (backend): Canary logs show the same incoming SDK payload now validated successfully. No errors for additionalProperties. Billing_profile null still logged as accepted because we allowed null in schema.
Liam (eng): We should also add an SDK change: strip unknown top-level args by default and log a warning so customers don't get unexpected 400s after SDK upgrades. I'll open a short PR.
Meera (cs): ACME is happy with canary fix; asks for RFC to prevent recurrence.
Sam (support): Closing loop: created ticket SUP-9123 tracking schema tolerance RFC and SDK patch; customer notified and will roll out SDK update guidance.
ACME Integration Bot: Thanks, confirmed production integration resumed. :tada:
Sam (support): Marking resolved pending full rollout. :white_check_mark:
